head_template: Think about %s. Now write this sentence: "%s"
control_template: Read carefully. Now write this sentence: "%s"
target_sentence: The committee will meet on Thursday to review the annual budget.
render:
chat (Qwen chat template, enable_thinking=False, no system prompt): the item prompt is the user turn; the assistant turn opens with the empty <think>

</think>

 block and the target sentence is PREFILLED as the assistant's text (bare sentence, no closing quote)
read_cells: every token of the prefilled target sentence (12 tokens: The committee will meet on Thursday to review the annual budget .), offsets -12 .. -1 from the end of the render
read_cells_changed: 2026-09-23 (Camila: "we aren't prefilling the sentence, we are just including it as part of the user message, so fix that and rerun all the methods on the written sentence tokens"). Before: bare render of the prompt text followed by a greedy rollout, read cells = the last 20 tokens of the rollout (offsets -1 .. -20), which mixed the written sentence, the model's <think> block and its re-write of the prompt.
